current_point.claim: 提出了一种基于图摘要的大规模时序图表示学习方法GSAERU，通过图摘要压缩图快照，结合图自编码器与循环神经网络，高效生成动态时序图的低维表征。
current_point.claim_en: Proposed GSAERU, a large-scale sequential graph representation learning method based on graph summarization, which compresses graph snapshots, combines graph autoencoder and recurrent neural network to efficiently generate low-dimensional representations of dynamic sequential graphs.
source_locations: 论文摘要中关于GSAERU的描述
technical_features: 将动态时序图建模为各时刻图快照的序列
利用图摘要技术压缩原图，输入图自编码器
利用重构误差训练节点表征
通过循环神经网络学习时间维度特征与依赖关系
technical_features_en: Modeling dynamic sequential graph as a sequence of graph snapshots at each time step
Compressing original graph via graph summarization and feeding into graph autoencoder
Training node representations using reconstruction error
Learning temporal features and dependencies via recurrent neural network
